uncertainties.finding: The English keeps the source's species-level contrast without assigning unsupported individual pronouns to the Guardians.

uncertainties.note: Source is a short disgruntled interjection; existing Hmph is an acceptable contextual rendering.
The source uses the honorific さん; existing “-sir” conveys the requested informal-address point but may be localized further during final editorial review.
The fragment intentionally begins the failed pronunciation of Kyle across the slice boundary.
妖怪 is rendered as monster; retain as a generic creature term unless the island glossary establishes a stricter English realm category.
The stammered attempt at Kyle crosses rows 958–961; existing English retains the failed pronunciation without adding a referent.
Crystal is literally described as growing; the existing naturalized wording preserves that unusual detail.
The source uses the term もりびと before explaining its Guardian role; the existing Guardian rendering remains coherent with the later definition.
The source says the party was separated from its original world; “separated from their world” preserves the unexplained referent.
Freize’s self-introduction and advisor role span three fragments; the draft preserves both roles without supplying extra affiliation.
シマシマさん is a descriptive nickname; retain the draft rendering unless the island glossary establishes a personal name.
Maruru’s affirmative carries a musical-note mark; confirm its preservation during final typography pass.

uncertainties.detail: 四者 (four parties) is rendered "the four"; the source leaves their exact institutional label implicit, so the draft preserves that ambiguity.
先に帰って asks the party to return ahead; "go back ahead of us" retains the direction, though its destination is deliberately implicit.
The source honorific さん is omitted in the existing English form; this is a localization-style choice, not a meaning loss.
仲良くなりたい literally expresses wanting to get along; "be friends" is a natural English rendering, but is slightly more categorical.

order: Independent meaning corrections first, locked glossary spelling normalization second.
